## "payload_type"

**Data type:**  
String

**Value:**  
Examples: "image", "master image", "ct scan".

**Description of metadata field:**  
Describes what the asset represents (such as an image or a ct scan).Lets us diffferentiate between the different payload types which are treated and reported on differently. It is a way of categorising the types of assets. 

**Populated by whom and when:**  
Ingestion server when metadata is created or integration server when running pipeline processes.

**Updated where and when:**  
Never.

**Generated by:**  
Ingestion server or integration server.

**Maps to in ARS:**  
payload_type

**Maps to in Specify:**  
Title [in part] in Specify attachment record

**Notes and issues:**  
None.
